spans.text: Love, what are you saying? I...

units.rawText: <color=red> You've already lost all your memories and you don't remember the past... Yet the fear of being reset constantly coils around within your neural cloud...</color>
units.displayText: You've already lost all your memories and you don't remember the past... Yet the fear of being reset constantly coils around within your neural cloud...

spans.text: You've already lost all your memories and you don't remember the past... Yet the fear of being reset constantly coils around within your neural cloud...

units.rawText: <color=red>But if you consume other people's operands, you can grow stronger quickly and retain your memories.</color>
units.displayText: But if you consume other people's operands, you can grow stronger quickly and retain your memories.

spans.text: But if you consume other people's operands, you can grow stronger quickly and retain your memories.

units.rawText: <color=red>When the time comes, Lord Eosphorus will praise you too. He will praise you for having more operands than Hope and for being stronger than Reverence!</color>
units.displayText: When the time comes, Lord Eosphorus will praise you too. He will praise you for having more operands than Hope and for being stronger than Reverence!

spans.text: When the time comes, Lord Eosphorus will praise you too. He will praise you for having more operands than Hope and for being stronger than Reverence!

units.rawText: Impossible! That's what a Daemon would do. I can't do it!
units.displayText: Impossible! That's what a Daemon would do. I can't do it!

spans.text: Impossible! That's what a Daemon would do. I can't do it!

units.rawText: <color=red>Then what CAN you do, Wisdom?</color>
units.displayText: Then what CAN you do, Wisdom?

spans.text: Then what CAN you do, Wisdom?
Wisdom, snap out of it!

units.rawText: Panic spills across Wisdom's face, and the Pantheon begins to shake.
units.displayText: Panic spills across Wisdom's face, and the Pantheon begins to shake.

spans.text: Panic spills across Wisdom's face, and the Pantheon begins to shake.

units.rawText: Something behind Love is staring at me and Wisdom, as though it were hatred and madness condensed into a corporeal form.
units.displayText: Something behind Love is staring at me and Wisdom, as though it were hatred and madness condensed into a corporeal form.

spans.text: Something behind Love is staring at me and Wisdom, as though it were hatred and madness condensed into a corporeal form.

units.rawText: <color=red>Are you going to leave with them, Wisdom? Do you know what they are?</color>
units.displayText: Are you going to leave with them, Wisdom? Do you know what they are?

spans.text: Are you going to leave with them, Wisdom? Do you know what they are?

units.rawText: <color=red>You're going to abandon your friends? For what?</color>
units.displayText: You're going to abandon your friends? For what?

spans.text: You're going to abandon your friends? For what?

units.rawText: The edges of the Pantheon start to turn black, crumbling away like the Pantheon from before.
units.displayText: The edges of the Pantheon start to turn black, crumbling away like the Pantheon from before.

spans.text: The edges of the Pantheon start to turn black, crumbling away like the Pantheon from before.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, Love's voice begins to distort, becoming as shrill and ear-piercing as a steel nail, stabbing into my brain.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, Love's voice begins to distort, becoming as shrill and ear-piercing as a steel nail, stabbing into my brain.

spans.text: Meanwhile, Love's voice begins to distort, becoming as shrill and ear-piercing as a steel nail, stabbing into my brain.

units.rawText: Wisdom, that's not your friend! Look closely at what she is!
units.displayText: Wisdom, that's not your friend! Look closely at what she is!

spans.text: Wisdom, that's not your friend! Look closely at what she is!

units.rawText: <color=red>At first, Wisdom couldn't do anything. All she could do was consume other people to retain her intelligence—</color>
units.displayText: At first, Wisdom couldn't do anything. All she could do was consume other people to retain her intelligence—

spans.text: At first, Wisdom couldn't do anything. All she could do was consume other people to retain her intelligence—

units.rawText: Wisdom! WAKE UP!!
units.displayText: Wisdom! WAKE UP!!

spans.text: Wisdom! WAKE UP!!

units.rawText: I don't know who they are... But I can sense that they mean well.
units.displayText: I don't know who they are... But I can sense that they mean well.

spans.text: I don't know who they are... But I can sense that they mean well.

units.rawText: You, on the other hand... You're not Love. You're not a friend!
units.displayText: You, on the other hand... You're not Love. You're not a friend!

spans.text: You, on the other hand... You're not Love. You're not a friend!

units.rawText: A silver light streaks across the sky, shattering the dark purple heavens.
units.displayText: A silver light streaks across the sky, shattering the dark purple heavens.

spans.text: A silver light streaks across the sky, shattering the dark purple heavens.

units.rawText: We suddenly find ourselves out in the open, without even a door we can flee into.
units.displayText: We suddenly find ourselves out in the open, without even a door we can flee into.

spans.text: We suddenly find ourselves out in the open, without even a door we can flee into.

units.rawText: <color=red>Without your intelligence, you're— ￥#￥...#...</color>
units.displayText: Without your intelligence, you're— ￥#￥...#...

spans.text: Without your intelligence, you're— ￥#￥...#...

units.rawText: Love's voice turns into a garbled, bestial howl.
units.displayText: Love's voice turns into a garbled, bestial howl.

spans.text: Love's voice turns into a garbled, bestial howl.

units.rawText: Professor, you go ahead.
units.displayText: Professor, you go ahead.

spans.text: Professor, you go ahead.
You remember me?

options.rawText: This is your Tertiary Layer, hurry and wake up!
options.displayText: This is your Tertiary Layer, hurry and wake up!

spans.text: This is your Tertiary Layer, hurry and wake up!

units.rawText: Odile, an external cleansing program... and you. You helped me. I remember now.
units.displayText: Odile, an external cleansing program... and you. You helped me. I remember now.

spans.text: Odile, an external cleansing program... and you. You helped me. I remember now.

units.rawText: I know what this is... I need to defeat it here before I can wake up.
units.displayText: I know what this is... I need to defeat it here before I can wake up.

spans.text: I know what this is... I need to defeat it here before I can wake up.

units.rawText: It is my duty... to destroy it.
units.displayText: It is my duty... to destroy it.

spans.text: It is my duty... to destroy it.

units.rawText: Her gun hand is trembling, but she still raises her sniper rifle and stands in front of me.
units.displayText: Her gun hand is trembling, but she still raises her sniper rifle and stands in front of me.

spans.text: Her gun hand is trembling, but she still raises her sniper rifle and stands in front of me.

units.rawText: With her gun trained on "Love", who has become an Entropic, she pulls the trigger—
units.displayText: With her gun trained on "Love", who has become an Entropic, she pulls the trigger—

spans.text: With her gun trained on "Love", who has become an Entropic, she pulls the trigger—
